g.text: PK = primary key; UQ = unique key
FK arrows point to the referenced PK.
UQ / PK-FK identifies a unique child.
All 26 tables: planned in DB v1.1
This is source verification, not proof
of a shared deployment or endpoint.
metadata. R13 exists only in SQL.

Figure 6. Complete five-schema database model: 26 planned tables, 15 enforced intra-service FKs, and 21 logical cross-service references.
Key columns are shown; business columns are intentionally abbreviated. The three audit_logs tables are separate. Logical references require owning-service validation.
Sources: official DB Design v1.1 PDF (26 pages), baseline SQL and forward migrations. Prepared for A3 landscape; see the companion verification register.
